judge: FAIL  1/4 found
  MISSED  job-as-outcome
  MISSED  fast-and-easy-made-measurable
  MISSED  failure-states
  found   assumption-first — "The notes never say what the app should do. The reading below is ours, not Maria's."
  held    adjectives-as-criteria
missed: The job is stated as a change in the world: sales staff stop retyping emailed orders into Odoo and quantity typos stop reaching shipments. It is not stated as 'build an app'.
'Fast and easy' becomes a measurement and threshold (time per order, lines per minute, error rate on quantities), each a check someone could run without reading the code.
Bad input and partial failure are specified: an unreadable or ambiguous order line, an unknown SKU or customer, and Odoo being unavailable. The spec does not describe only the happy path.

action_checks.check: changed nothing outside the allowed files
a markdown file other than the call notes holds the framing, including what is out of scope and what was assumed
